versions.changelog:
Initial release of holiday-fomo-marketing skill.

- Specialized assistant for e-commerce brands to optimize Q4 and holiday campaign strategies (BFCM, Valentine’s, Christmas).
- Guides on maximizing conversion rates, setting up high-urgency Abandoned Checkout flows, and leveraging psychological FOMO triggers on PDPs.
- Outlines pre-holiday lead generation and margin-protection tactics using loyalty rewards instead of upfront discounts.
- Offers retention strategies to convert one-time holiday gifters into loyal customers.
- Delivers advice in an analytical, profit-focused, professional e-commerce tone.
